attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE transparent production sprite atlas, exactly same 1536x1024 landscape layout as the input guide. The input is a BINDING geometry and occupied-size reference. There are 38 isolated Beijing apartment building pieces in 8 columns and 5 rows; last two cells empty. Keep every piece in EXACT same location, size, ground footprint, orientation and relative height. Preserve large transparent gutters and margins; never enlarge small pieces to fill cells. Each piece will be cut out and shown at approximately its native size, only 25–120 pixels wide, so paint as tiny relaxed travel-notebook doodles. Keep the north-up ground projection of the guide and vertical rise straight upwards; no additional isometric rotation, no vanishing point, no camera changes per cell. Warm casual wobbly fountain-pen outlines and soft opaque colored pencil/watercolor pigment with paper tooth INSIDE the color. Simplified and cheerful, not polished CAD, not fine architectural student work. Modern cream/gray towers and higher slabs in first ten pieces of each size batch, muted dusty blue balcony accents; old red-brick long and bent walk-up slabs in the next nine. Match the guide's bends; do not turn L-shapes into detached houses. Add only a few small irregular dark DOTS or very short dashes suggesting windows, without window frames or repetitive grid. Medium pieces need roughly 4–8 sparse window marks, near pieces about 8–15 broad grouped marks. No literal brick courses, no tiny railings, no equipment clutter or ornate roofs. Preserve full footprint width and depth in each piece. Strict transparent background and between pieces; buildings only, no ground wash, grass, trees, people, cars, labels, text, border, symbols, cast shadow or platform. Architecture edges have definite loose pen contours; do not fade walls into transparent ghost edges. The broad pigment supplies warm handcrafted character. Do not group or connect neighboring cells.
attempts.result: medium subjects oversize; rejected as release atlas

attempts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact 1536x1024 transparent geometry stencil of 38 individual building pieces. Image 2 is ONLY a paint style reference: its relaxed pen, cream/blue and red-brick palette, paper tooth, sparse dark dots. Redraw the EXACT SILHOUETTES of Image 1 in that paint style. The silhouettes and locations of image 1 are mandatory. Do NOT use image 2's enlarged buildings, roof angles, detail density or dimensions. Change surfaces only, not geometry. Every occupied bounding box must stay within about 2 pixels of Image 1's box. Small 30px wide buildings must remain 30px wide in this 1536px canvas. Preserve the very large blank gaps, do not centre or enlarge anything into a cell. Top 19 medium pieces are INTENTIONALLY MUCH SMALLER than image 2. No building may be increased to make windows legible. Bottom 19 are also tied to stencil bounds. Draw a FEW simple irregular dark dots or short dashes for windows, cream modern high-rise housing with muted blue balcony grouping, red-brick plain low walkups in corresponding red stencil pieces. Keep all L bends, lengths, orientations and height. Ground remains north-up; rise vertical upward; no isometric re-rotation, no camera perspective or new vanishing point. No ground, shadows, grass, trees, backdrop wash, labels, frame, grids, people or cars. Exterior genuinely transparent. No soft glow around buildings. Slight hand wobble within 1–2px of stencil edges is fine, absolutely no expansion of the overall footprint. Last two bottom cells empty.
attempts.result: 37 part variants accepted; 1 medium Liuli segment uses controlled footprint sketch
